resources.string: Draws your DiscoBar items in the status bar

DiscoBar draws the items you add (network speed, timer, calendar, tools…) on top of the status bar. Android only allows that through an accessibility service.

What DiscoBar does with it: it reads the layout of the status bar, and nothing else, to find free space; it copies the colour of the status bar clock so your items match; and it runs system actions such as screenshot or lock when you pick them in its Tools menu.

It does not read other apps' windows, does not watch your keyboard, mouse or touches, and has no internet access.
